control: Each install has a random 24-byte secret key. Others only ever see a SHA-256 hash of it as the member id, so seeing an id doesn't let anyone pose as that member.
No passwords or sign-up. The key stays on the PC except when sent to the Worker over TLS.
A fresh certificate per party. Each side accepts only the certificate fingerprint it received through the rendezvous, so nobody else can connect in or pose as the host.
Lock, password and removals are checked in the Worker, so a modified app can't get past them.
Only a SHA-256 hash of the password with the lobby code leaves the PC. 5 wrong guesses a minute per lobby.
A player's home-network address is passed on only to someone connecting from the same internet address.
Hidden members aren't listed to anyone, and invites to them are dropped.
Invites: 20 a minute, one per 5 s to the same person. Chat: 300 characters, 5 per 5 s. Pictures: PNG or JPEG up to 64 KB, one change per 5 s. Searches: 20 per 10 s.
Counts only, behind an admin token kept as a Worker secret.
